topic: meeting a friend at a café
title: En el café
text:
Hola, Pedro:
Estoy en el café de la esquina.
¿Vienes?
translation:
Hi, Pedro:
I'm at the café on the corner.
Are you coming?

questions.q: Why does the writer send the message?
options: To invite Pedro to the café

questions.explain: Pedro is asked to come to the café.

title: Horario
text:
Tienda abierta de lunes a viernes.
De 8 a 18.
Sábado: cerrado.
translation:
Shop open Monday to Friday.
From 8 to 6.
Saturday: closed.

questions.explain: It gives the days and hours.
The shop is 'abierta' on weekdays: open.

title: Un café
text:
—Buenos días.
—Buenos días. Un café, por favor.
—¿Con leche?
—Sí, gracias.
translation:
"Good morning."
"Good morning. A coffee, please."
"With milk?"
"Yes, thank you."

questions.q: How does the customer want the coffee?

questions.explain: It is the polite word for please.
